exams.title: GitHub Foundations
exams.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; basic computer and web familiarity is enough.

exams.title: GitHub Copilot
exams.study_prerequisites: GitHub fundamentals, a basic software-development workflow, and GitHub Copilot access for the hands-on labs.

exams.title: GitHub Actions
exams.study_prerequisites: Git and GitHub fundamentals, repositories, pull requests, and basic YAML.

exams.title: GitHub Enterprise Administrator
exams.study_prerequisites: GitHub repositories, organizations, identity fundamentals, and an enterprise-capable test environment for complete labs.

exams.title: GitHub Advanced Security
exams.study_prerequisites: GitHub repositories, pull requests, Actions fundamentals, and basic secure-development concepts.

exams.title: Developing AI Apps and Agents on Azure
exams.study_prerequisites: Python or C#, REST/API fundamentals, Azure fundamentals, and an Azure subscription or approved sandbox for complete labs.

exams.title: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect
exams.study_prerequisites: Microsoft 365 or Power Platform familiarity, solution-architecture fundamentals, and access to suitable Copilot or agent environments for complete labs.

exams.title: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
exams.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; basic cloud and technology familiarity is helpful.

exams.title: Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals
exams.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; basic relational, non-relational, and analytics vocabulary is helpful.

exams.title: Microsoft Power Platform Fundamentals
exams.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; familiarity with business processes and Microsoft 365 is helpful.

exams.title: Microsoft Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals
exams.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; basic cloud, identity, and security vocabulary is helpful.

exams.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot and Agent Administration Fundamentals
exams.study_prerequisites: Microsoft 365 fundamentals and basic administration, identity, security, and governance vocabulary.

exams.title: Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals
exams.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; basic Azure and cloud concepts are helpful for the Foundry portions.

exams.title: Terraform Associate (004)
exams.study_prerequisites: Basic terminal skills and an understanding of on-premises and cloud architecture; hands-on Terraform practice in a disposable environment is strongly recommended.

exams.title: Terraform Authoring and Operations Professional
exams.study_prerequisites: Terraform Associate-level knowledge, Linux terminal fluency, HCL and structured-data experience, cloud credentials and networking knowledge, and extensive production Terraform authoring and operations experience.

exams.title: Vault Associate (003)
exams.study_prerequisites: Basic terminal, on-premises or cloud architecture, and security knowledge; hands-on Vault practice in a disposable environment is strongly recommended.

exams.title: Vault Operations Professional
exams.study_prerequisites: Vault Associate-level knowledge, Linux and networking skill, PKI/TLS/PGP and security fundamentals, container operations, and substantial production Vault experience.

exams.title: Microsoft Azure Administrator
exams.study_prerequisites: Azure fundamentals plus practical operating-system, networking, server, virtualization, PowerShell or Azure CLI, Resource Manager or Bicep, and Microsoft Entra ID experience.

exams.title: Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions
exams.study_prerequisites: Azure Administrator Associate-level implementation knowledge plus advanced experience in networking, virtualization, identity, security, business continuity, disaster recovery, data platforms, governance, Azure development, and DevOps processes.

exams.title: Designing and Implementing Microsoft Azure Networking Solutions
exams.study_prerequisites: Hands-on Azure compute, storage, and networking administration plus strong TCP/IP, CIDR/subnetting, DNS, routing, VPN, firewall, load-balancing, encryption, high-availability, and troubleshooting fundamentals.

exams.title: Planning and Administering Microsoft Azure for SAP Workloads
exams.study_prerequisites: SAP HANA, NetWeaver, Business Suite, Basis, operating-system, database, migration, clustering, backup, and disaster-recovery experience plus Azure Administrator Associate-level compute, storage, networking, identity, governance, monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code knowledge.

exams.title: Configuring and Operating Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop
exams.study_prerequisites: Azure administration plus Windows desktop/server, virtualization, Microsoft Entra ID and AD DS, Group Policy or Intune, networking, SMB and Kerberos, storage, profiles, application delivery, security, monitoring, scripting, backup, and disaster-recovery experience.

exams.title: Designing and Implementing Microsoft DevOps Solutions
exams.study_prerequisites: Hands-on Azure administration or development, Git and source-control workflows, CI/CD, testing, identity and security, infrastructure as code, monitoring, and experience implementing both GitHub and Azure DevOps solutions.

exams.title: Administering Windows Server Hybrid Core Infrastructure
exams.study_prerequisites: Several years of Windows Server experience plus practical AD DS, Group Policy, PowerShell, Hyper-V, DNS, DHCP, SMB/storage, networking, Azure VM, Microsoft Entra hybrid identity, Azure Arc, and monitoring knowledge.

exams.title: Configuring Windows Server Hybrid Advanced Services
exams.study_prerequisites: Several years of Windows Server experience plus practical security hardening, AD DS, failover clustering, Hyper-V, storage, backup and disaster recovery, migration, Azure VM, Azure Monitor, and troubleshooting knowledge.

exams.title: Administering Windows Server
exams.study_prerequisites: Several years of Windows Server experience plus practical AD DS, Group Policy, PowerShell and delegated administration, Hyper-V and Azure VMs, DNS/DHCP, SMB and Windows storage, Azure Arc, security hardening, Azure Monitor, and evidence-led troubleshooting.

exams.title: Administering Microsoft Azure SQL Solutions
exams.study_prerequisites: Practical SQL Server and Azure SQL administration, T-SQL, relational engine fundamentals, security, performance tuning, automation, backup and restore, migration, and high availability experience.

exams.title: Designing and Implementing Cloud-Native Applications Using Microsoft Azure Cosmos DB
exams.study_prerequisites: Application development in C# or Java, JSON, the Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL query language and SDK, PowerShell, and Azure resource-management fundamentals.

exams.title: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Azure Databricks
exams.study_prerequisites: Practical SQL and Python/PySpark, Delta Lake, streaming and batch data engineering, Azure identity/storage/networking, Unity Catalog governance, and production deployment and troubleshooting experience.

exams.title: Implementing Analytics Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
exams.study_prerequisites: Hands-on Microsoft Fabric and Power BI experience across lakehouses, warehouses, eventhouses, OneLake, SQL, KQL, Power Query, notebooks, dimensional modeling, DAX, semantic-model security/performance, Git and deployment pipelines.

exams.title: Developing AI-Enabled Database Solutions
exams.study_prerequisites: T-SQL development, relational and JSON design, Microsoft SQL platforms, security, performance tuning, Git and CI/CD, APIs and change processing, plus model, embedding, vector search, and RAG fundamentals.

exams.title: Developing AI Cloud Solutions on Azure
exams.study_prerequisites: Python and Azure SDKs, container images and orchestration, Cosmos DB and PostgreSQL/pgvector, Managed Redis, messaging and events, Functions, managed identity, Key Vault, OpenTelemetry, KQL, vectors and RAG.

exams.title: Operationalizing Machine Learning and Generative AI Solutions
exams.study_prerequisites: Python, machine learning, Azure Machine Learning, Microsoft Foundry, GitHub Actions, Azure CLI, Bicep, CI/CD, evaluation, monitoring, RAG and fine-tuning fundamentals.

exams.title: Designing and Implementing Multi-Agent AI Solutions
exams.study_prerequisites: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103), plus production Python, Azure compute/network/storage/data, Microsoft Foundry, agent frameworks, MCP, RAG, identity, security, evaluation, observability, and CI/CD experience.

exams.title: Designing and Building Integrated AI Agent Solutions in Copilot Studio
exams.study_prerequisites: Advanced Copilot Studio building plus Power Fx, Dataverse, Power Platform environments and solutions, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Foundry, Adaptive Cards, RAG, MCP, A2A, prompt engineering, REST APIs, connectors, identity, governance, evaluation, telemetry, and ALM experience.

exams.title: Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect
exams.study_prerequisites: Expert skill in at least one security domain plus practical experience across identity and access, platform protection, security operations, data and AI security, application security, hybrid and multicloud infrastructure, architecture tradeoffs, governance, resilience, and controlled delivery.

exams.title: Microsoft Security Operations Analyst
exams.study_prerequisites: Practical security operations across Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Entra ID, Purview and Defender for Cloud, plus KQL, Windows/Linux, Microsoft 365, Azure, incident response, threat hunting, automation, and current AI-agent/Copilot concepts.

exams.title: Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator
exams.study_prerequisites: Practical Microsoft Entra ID, Azure, Microsoft 365 and AD DS experience plus PowerShell and KQL; hands-on identity lifecycle, strong authentication, Conditional Access, hybrid identity, enterprise applications, workload identities, governance, privileged access, and monitoring experience is strongly recommended.

exams.title: Microsoft Cloud and AI Security Engineer
exams.study_prerequisites: Practical Azure and hybrid administration across identity, compute, networking and storage; strong Microsoft Entra knowledge; Microsoft 365 familiarity; and hands-on security engineering with Key Vault, Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, containers, application platforms, Microsoft Foundry, agents, AI gateways, and Security Copilot.

exams.title: Administering Information Security in Microsoft 365
exams.study_prerequisites: Practical Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Purview administration plus familiarity with PowerShell, Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Defender XDR, and Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps; hands-on experience with classification, sensitivity labels, DLP, endpoint controls, retention, Insider Risk Management, Audit, eDiscovery, and AI data security is strongly recommended.

exams.title: Microsoft 365 Administrator
exams.study_prerequisites: Functional experience across Microsoft 365 workloads and Microsoft Entra ID plus working knowledge of networking, AD DS, DNS and PowerShell; hands-on tenant, hybrid identity, Defender XDR, Defender for Office 365, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud Apps, Purview and Conditional Access administration is strongly recommended.

exams.title: AI Services Administrator Associate
exams.study_prerequisites: Hands-on Microsoft 365 administration across Entra ID, Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, Defender and Purview, plus practical Microsoft 365 Copilot, Agent 365, licensing, identity, data governance, incident response, reporting, PowerShell and Microsoft Graph experience.

exams.title: Managing and Securing Microsoft 365 Endpoints by Using Intune
exams.study_prerequisites: Strong Windows client and Microsoft 365 administration plus practical Microsoft Intune, Entra device identity and Conditional Access, Autopilot, Android/Apple/macOS enrollment, Defender for Endpoint, application packaging, endpoint security, Windows 365, PowerShell, Graph, reporting and troubleshooting experience.

exams.title: Managing Microsoft Teams
exams.study_prerequisites: Practical Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 administration across identity, groups, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange, Purview, Defender, networking, devices, external collaboration, apps, meetings, Teams Phone, PowerShell, Graph, reporting and troubleshooting.

exams.title: Collaboration Communications Systems Engineer
exams.study_prerequisites: Practical Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 administration plus networking, telecommunications, SIP/PSTN, audiovisual and meeting-room fundamentals; hands-on experience with Teams Phone, Direct Routing, emergency calling, meetings/events, Teams Rooms and devices, PowerShell, Call Analytics and CQD is strongly recommended.

exams.title: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
exams.study_prerequisites: Hands-on data-engineering experience with loading patterns, data architecture and orchestration plus practical Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, lakehouse, warehouse, Eventhouse, Dataflow Gen2, pipelines, notebooks, security, monitoring, SQL, PySpark and KQL skills.

exams.title: Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst
exams.study_prerequisites: Practical data-analysis experience plus hands-on Power BI Desktop and service skills across Power Query, dimensional modeling, DAX, report design, workspaces, apps, gateways, refresh, permissions, row-level security, accessibility, performance, and current Fabric/Copilot integration.

exams.title: Microsoft Power Platform Developer
exams.study_prerequisites: Hands-on Power Platform development across Dataverse, canvas and model-driven apps, Power Automate and solutions, plus practical Power Fx, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, JSON, OpenAPI, REST/OData, Azure Functions, identity, security, ALM, testing and troubleshooting experience.

exams.title: Building Intelligent Applications
exams.study_prerequisites: Practical low-code solution-building experience across Dataverse, model-driven and canvas apps, Power Automate, Power Fx and solutions, plus familiarity with Power Pages, Copilot Studio agents, AI Builder prompts/models, environment governance, security roles, responsible AI, ALM, accessibility, testing and troubleshooting.

exams.title: AI Business Professional
exams.study_prerequisites: Basic Microsoft 365 business-user experience in Outlook, Word, Teams, PowerPoint and Excel plus hands-on use of Microsoft 365 Copilot prompts, conversations, agents, Researcher, Analyst, Pages and Notebooks; no coding or app-development experience is required.

exams.title: AI Transformation Leader
exams.study_prerequisites: Business decision-making or change-leadership experience plus familiarity with Microsoft 365, generative AI, Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft Foundry concepts; no coding experience is required.

exams.title: Accelerating Sales Pipelines with AI in Dynamics 365
exams.study_prerequisites: Intermediate Microsoft Power Platform configuration, Dynamics 365 Sales and lead-to-cash process knowledge, model-driven app and Dataverse experience, and the ability to build Power Automate cloud flows.

exams.title: Transforming Contact Center Experiences with AI in Dynamics 365
exams.study_prerequisites: Contact-center/CCaaS implementation knowledge across voice and digital channels, representatives/supervisors, routing and service operations, plus experience with Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Power BI, Teams and Microsoft Foundry.

exams.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Service Functional Consultant
exams.study_prerequisites: Applied Dynamics 365 Customer Service and service-management knowledge across cases, knowledge, SLAs, queues, routing, representative workspace and Customer Voice, plus Dataverse, model-driven app, Power Automate, Teams and basic solution-architecture experience.

exams.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant
exams.study_prerequisites: Applied accounting and Dynamics 365 Finance experience across general ledger, currencies, journals, cash and bank, tax, receivables, payables, budgeting and fixed assets, plus the ability to reconcile source documents, subledgers and vouchers to the general ledger.

exams.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management Functional Consultant
exams.study_prerequisites: Applied supply-chain and Dynamics 365 SCM experience across product/inventory data, procurement, sales, quality, assets, advanced warehouse/mobile execution, transportation, costing and master planning, plus the ability to trace order, inventory, work and planning states end to end.

exams.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations Apps Developer
exams.study_prerequisites: Professional Dynamics 365 finance and operations development experience with X++, Visual Studio/AOT, extension models, Azure DevOps, ALM/environments, reporting, data entities/APIs, Power Platform integration, role/XDS security, automated testing and evidence-based performance tuning.

exams.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central Functional Consultant
exams.study_prerequisites: Applied Business Central functional-consulting experience across company setup and migration, security, dimensions, workflows, financial configuration, posting groups, receivables, payables, fixed assets, sales, purchasing, inventory, journals, corrections and reconciliations, plus the ability to trace documents through subledgers and the general ledger.

exams.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central Developer
exams.study_prerequisites: Applied Business Central and AL development experience across extension architecture, Visual Studio Code, app configuration/dependencies, tables/pages/reports/XMLports/codeunits/queries/permissions, Business Central data and document patterns, automated testing, telemetry, lifecycle upgrades and secure REST/API integration.

exams.title: Databricks Certified Data Analyst Associate
exams.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; the official exam guide recommends related training and six months of hands-on Databricks experience. Practice ANSI SQL, relational and dimensional modeling, data quality, SQL warehouses, query diagnosis, AI/BI dashboards, Genie and Unity Catalog governance.

exams.title: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate
exams.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; the official exam guide recommends related training and six months of hands-on Databricks experience. Practice SQL, basic Python/PySpark, ETL, cloud storage, identity, Lakeflow Jobs, CI/CD and Unity Catalog governance.

exams.title: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional
exams.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; the official guide highly recommends related training and one year of hands-on production data-engineering experience across Python/SQL/Spark, batch and streaming pipelines, CDC, orchestration, testing, sharing/federation, observability, cost/performance, privacy/governance, CI/CD and dimensional modeling.

exams.title: Databricks Certified Machine Learning Associate
exams.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; the official guide recommends six months of hands-on experience. Working Python, scikit-learn, Spark ML, statistics, data preparation, Unity Catalog feature/model governance, MLflow, evaluation and batch/stream/real-time inference are practical prerequisites.

exams.title: Databricks Certified Machine Learning Professional
exams.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; the official guide recommends one year of hands-on Databricks experience. Practice scalable Spark/single-node/Ray ML, distributed tuning, point-in-time and online/on-demand features, advanced MLflow, deploy-code environments, complete test gates, automated retraining, sliced monitoring/alerts and controlled custom-model rollout.

exams.title: Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate
exams.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; the official guide recommends related training and six months of hands-on experience. Practice Python/SQL, prompt and model selection, governed document preparation, RAG and AI Search, traced agent/tool/MCP design, MLflow evaluation, secure Apps/serving, Unity Catalog controls, CI/CD, monitoring, cost control and calibrated feedback.

exams.title: Databricks Certified Associate Developer for Apache Spark
exams.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; the official guide recommends related training and six months of hands-on Apache Spark experience. Practice Python/SQL, driver/executor and job/stage/task execution, schemas and I/O, DataFrame operations, joins/aggregates/UDFs, partitions/shuffles/AQE/UI/log diagnosis, Structured Streaming recovery/state, Spark Connect and Pandas API on Spark.

exams.title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
exams.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; basic technology and business vocabulary plus limited AWS exposure are helpful, and a controlled AWS sandbox supports the labs.

exams.title: AWS Certified AI Practitioner
exams.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; the target candidate has up to six months of AWS AI/ML exposure and uses but does not necessarily build solutions. Basic AWS services, shared responsibility, IAM and pricing vocabulary are useful.

exams.title: AWS Certified AI Business Strategist
exams.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; AWS recommends basic AI familiarity, strategic awareness of relevant AWS frameworks and tools, and about six months working with or alongside AI initiatives. No coding, AWS implementation experience, or other AWS certification is required.

exams.title: AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer - Associate
exams.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; AWS targets candidates with about one year deploying, managing, and operating workloads. Practice console/CLI, scripting, operating systems, containers, CI/CD, IaC, monitoring/logging, networking, security, multi-account operations, incident response, backup/recovery and performance/cost troubleshooting.

exams.title: AWS Certified Data Engineer - Associate
exams.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; AWS targets candidates with two to three years of data-engineering experience and one to two years of hands-on AWS experience. Practice SQL, batch/stream/CDC ingestion, distributed processing, store and schema design, orchestration, IaC, data quality, monitoring, IAM, Lake Formation, KMS, privacy, lineage, replay and recovery.
